action.action-desc: Ms. Escobar submitted the following resolution; which was referred to the Committee on Rules

form.official-title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 4393) to secure the border and reform the immigration laws.

section.text: That immediately upon adoption of this resolution, the House shall proceed to the consideration in the House of the bill (H.R. 4393) to secure the border and reform the immigration laws. All points of order against consideration of the bill are waived. The bill shall be considered as read. All points of order against provisions in the bill are waived. The previous question shall be considered as ordered on the bill, and on any further amendment thereto, to final passage without intervening motion except: (1) one hour of debate equally divided and controlled by the chair and ranking minority member of the Committee on the Judiciary or their respective designees; and (2) one motion to recommit.
Clause 1(c) of rule XIX and clause 8 of rule XX shall not apply to the consideration of H.R. 4393.
The Clerk shall transmit to the Senate a message that the House has passed H.R. 4393 no later than three calendar days after passage.
